decision.next: Review training-period difference signal and route/action coverage before any budget reallocation.

schema.fixed300_level_error: prediction minus frozen native truth in low/high action order
schema.gain_sign: low cost minus high cost; positive chooses7.5 seconds; ties choose0

action_design.interpretation: No outcome fit. Rank and action coverage do not establish control benefit.

interpretation.scope: Twelve design cells reuse three pre-shock physical prefixes across the scene labels; no independent confirmation or deployment claim.
interpretation.source_truth: Original single-action reference continues policy/model learning and future calibration; frozen branch suffixes disable both. Their chosen-action differences are descriptive, not failed exact reproduction.
interpretation.signal: Paired300-second gains compare common-prefix actions. Saved background residuals diagnose level variation on the same frozen suffix; true training-period contrasts were not fitted.
interpretation.matching: Per-model metrics have their own supported states. Only common_metrics compare every listed model on the same state IDs; unsupported is never a zero.
interpretation.proxy: base_analytic and global58 have only global-next endpoint predictions. Against fixed300 they are cross-endpoint direction proxies.
interpretation.next_budget: Any later trained paired outcome consumes one slot per action, two per pair, within a newly declared285-slot allocation. Current diagnostic outcomes enter no fit.
